role: The networked local player: sends the per-tick C03 move/look packet and the C0B sprint/sneak actions, and routes drop, chat, swing, respawn, close-window and abilities through the send queue.
scope_reason: Its sendMotionUpdates output is exactly what the server tick consumes each row; replay compares it.

members.note: the tick's client-to-server packets are fields of struct client_out, applied by the server half in send order
